svg.title: The recommended 008004 footprint
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. The recommended 008004 (0201 metric) footprint: two pads 0.2 mm long and 0.2 mm wide on a 0.3 mm pitch, leaving a 0.1 mm gap. The 0.25 × 0.125 mm part sits with both metal ends on the pads. Solder mask expansion 0 (untested footprint).

g.text: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Footprint from the table in PCB-DFA-029.
